report_1: Cedar United goalkeeper Kim Park will miss the next match due to an ankle injury, the club confirmed. No return date was provided for Park's recovery.
report_2: Cedar United appointed Jo Vale as head coach on Monday, with a two-year contract securing her tenure. The appointment marks a new leadership chapter for the squad.
report_3: Cedar United secured a 2–1 victory against Vale City on Sunday. The win extends the team's recent momentum on the pitch.
